Block an app via defender and only allow excluded devices to access.

Once the app has been unsanctioned, it will automatically disabled on all devices as its connected to Defender for endpoint.

1.Extract the list of users who needs access to the site/app.

1. Here we are only giving access to 30 people, we will extract the device info using KQL. (This can be done manually via Intune)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. Once the device list has been extracted, now it's time to tag the device.

2. To tag the device, you can either use the bulk tag method via the link below, or just manually tag the device.

To manually tag the device, navigate to Defender>Asset>Devices.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. Once the device has been tagged. Its time to create a device group and unsanctioned the app.
2. Navigate to Defender>Settings>endpoint>Device grps.

  
 

![](data:image/png;base64,)

1. To unsanctioned the app, navigate to Cloud apps>cloud discover>Search the apps. Then unsanctioned the app and exclude the device you created.  
      
     

![](data:image/png;base64,)
